project.name: Muskan tours
project.productType: Travel agency marketing and live flight search

must: Keep live-provider credentials on the server only
Show loading, empty, error, test and live states honestly
Recheck a selected airline offer before booking contact
avoid: Decorative dashboard chrome that conflicts with the travel brand
Presenting test-mode prices as live fares

decisions: Use a clean vertical flight-results list matching the existing navy, teal and saffron identity.
Collect selected-flight requests through a focused contact dialog and send them to Muskan's private admin workspace.
Use a compact operations dashboard with a five-stage request pipeline: new, contacted, quoted, confirmed and closed.
